text: Among the lonely green hills of Wessex. <break time="0.8s" /> There once stood a solitary cottage. <break time="0.8s" /> Called Higher Crowstairs. <break time="0.8s" /> Far from any village. <break time="0.8s" /> And open to every wind. <break time="0.8s" /> On the night of March 28. <break time="0.8s" /> In a year long ago. <break time="0.8s" /> A fierce storm swept over the hills. <break time="0.8s" /> And the rain struck the walls. <break time="0.8s" /> Like flying arrows. <break time="0.8s" /> Inside, however. <break time="0.8s" /> All was warm and bright. <break time="0.8s" /> For Shepherd Fennel and his wife. <break time="0.8s" /> Were holding a party. <break time="0.8s" /> To celebrate the christening. <break time="0.8s" /> Of their second daughter. <break time="0.8s" /> Nineteen people. <break time="0.8s" /> Most of them shepherds and farm workers. <break time="0.8s" /> With their wives. <break time="0.8s" /> Were dancing. <break time="0.8s" /> To the music of a fiddle. <break time="0.8s" /> Played by a boy of twelve. <break time="0.8s" /> Missus Fennel. <break time="0.8s" /> A careful housekeeper. <break time="0.8s" /> Secretly worried that the long dancing would make her guests. <break time="0.8s" /> Hungry and thirsty enough. <break time="0.8s" /> To empty her cupboards. <break time="0.8s" /> At about the same time. <break time="0.8s" /> A lonely figure. <break time="0.8s" /> Was climbing the hill. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the rain. <break time="0.8s" /> Having come on foot. <break time="0.8s" /> From the direction of the distant town of Casterbridge. <break time="0.8s" /> Tall and thin. <break time="0.8s" /> With his clothes soaked by the storm. <break time="0.8s" /> He stopped near the door. <break time="0.8s" /> And drank thirstily. <break time="0.8s" /> From a stone basin full of rainwater. <break time="0.8s" /> He listened for a while. <break time="0.8s" /> To the music and laughter inside. <break time="0.8s" /> As though he could not decide. <break time="0.8s" /> Whether to knock. <break time="0.8s" /> Or to walk on into the dark.
